messages.author: 14f16be058072eb4
messages.subject: default account
parts:
Hi,

I just killed a previous account and created a new one, but when I use deployApp() I have to specify on which account I want to push my app: the default value is still the previous account, even if accounts() returns only the new one.

How to fix that ?

Thanks,
Fred

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] default account
parts:
Fred,

The list of accounts is defined by a config file on your local machine. You can adjust this config file, but it's location depends on your OS. You can see the relveant R code here.

-Andy

messages.author: 14f16be058072eb4
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] default account
parts:
Hi Tareef,

I can't see your reply in the thread, just in my emails...

You're right!
The app directory contains a shinyapps subdir with 2 dirs inside: one named with my old account, and one with my new account.
Both contain its own .dcf with the same app name, but the corresponding account name, bundleId and url.

Suppressing an account do not remove the corresponding subdir and .dcf in apps.
I removed the old one manually, and everything works fine.

Fred
